Name: MISSION_MANAGEMENT_PARAM_ST
Description: Missions: how many times the objective must be completed, and the map-pattern condition used while the mission is active.

Fields.Name: Disable Param - Network Test
Fields.Description: Set: the row is left out of the network test build. Retail: set on 1 row.

Fields.Name: Mission ID
Fields.Description: Mission ID of this row (personal-story missions: hero number × 100 + mission number). The game finds the row by this value. Retail: equals the row ID.

Fields.Name: Required Progress Count
Fields.Description: The mission is completed once its progress count reaches this value. Retail: 1 on most missions, 2, 3 or 5 on a few.

Fields.Name: Unknown Matchmaking Flag
Fields.Description: Only bit 0 is used. Set: the active mission reports "off" for a flag sent with matchmaking. Its effect is not established. Retail: 1 on missions 303 (Defeat the Centaur), 601 (Defeat the Night Servant) and 902.

Fields.Name: Map Lot Condition ID
Fields.Description: MapPatternMapLotCondition row that sets up the expedition for this mission (map pattern conditions); also shown on the matchmaking screen. -1: none.
